All Modern Warfare 4 Mastery camos – Multiplayer, DMZ, and Warzone

Get ready to grind it out.

Scott Duwe | Senior Staff Writer
Published: Aug 21, 2026 12:25 pm
Updated: Aug 21, 2026 1:07 pm

Image via Activision

The camo grind begins again in Modern Warfare 4, as Call of Duty players have come to expect.

Recommended Videos
1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE

Mastery camos return in MW4, giving CoD grinders the ultimate goal to achieve when it comes to playing any of its three modes: multiplayer, DMZ, and Warzone. Your prize? Some of the sexiest, shiniest animated camos the game has to offer.

Here’s what we know so far about the nine unlockable Mastery camos to grab in MW4.

Table of contents

  • All Mastery camos in MW4
    • Mercurial Drift (Multiplayer)
    • Polyatomic Reforged (Multiplayer)
    • Orion Reforged (Multiplayer)
    • Parallax (Warzone)
    • Damascus Reforged (Warzone)
    • Empyros (Warzone)
    • Chiral (DMZ)
    • Ripple Tide (DMZ)
    • Helio (DMZ)

All Mastery camos in MW4

In MW4, there’s a “shared camo grind” so “no matter what mode you’re playing, you’re grinding those camos.” But once you finish unlocking base camos, the Mastery grind begins. There’s three camos each to unlock in multiplayer, DMZ, and Warzone, so here are all nine.

Mercurial Drift (Multiplayer)

Polyatomic Reforged (Multiplayer)

Orion Reforged (Multiplayer)

Parallax (Warzone)

Damascus Reforged (Warzone)

Empyros (Warzone)

Chiral (DMZ)

Ripple Tide (DMZ)

Helio (DMZ)

More info on MW4’s camo grind is expected to come before launch.
